files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to the images: PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF. Logos, icons, illustrations, scans of drawings and signatures work best.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Colour keeps every colour layer. Black and white makes one solid shape from the dark parts: best for signatures, line art, stencils, cutting machines (Cricut, laser).

colorDetail.title: Colour detail
colorDetail.description: Colour mode, 1–7: lower merges similar shades into fewer, flatter layers (smaller files); higher keeps more shades.

layerDifference.title: Layer merge
layerDifference.description: Colour mode, 0–255: how different two neighbouring colours must be to stay separate layers.

filterSpeckle.title: Remove specks smaller than (px)
filterSpeckle.description: Drops noise and tiny spots whose side is smaller than this. Raise it for scans and photos.

curveMode.title: Shapes
curveMode.description: Smooth curves for logos and drawings, straight polygons for geometric art, or square pixels for pixel art.

cornerThreshold.title: Corner angle (degrees)
cornerThreshold.description: Angles sharper than this stay corners; the rest become curves.

threshold.title: Black and white: threshold
threshold.description: 0–255: pixels darker than this become the shape.

invert.title: Black and white: trace the light parts
invert.description: Use the light areas as the shape instead (light logo on a dark background).

color.title: Black and white: shape colour
color.description: Hex colour of the traced shape, e.g. #1a7f37. Default black.

background.title: Background for transparent images
background.description: Colour mode: hex colour to put behind transparent pixels before tracing, e.g. #ffffff. Leave empty to keep transparency.

maxSize.title: Max image side (px)
maxSize.description: Larger images are scaled down before tracing (tracing time grows fast with size). The SVG scales to any size anyway.

timeoutSecs.title: Time limit per image (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: An image that takes longer is skipped with an error (not charged).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
